nodes.description: BotProtected.owner: privileged address, assigned from tx.origin in BaconToken constructor and used as sole authorization for delegate and list.
BotProtected.protectionFromBots: externally controlled address invoked with low-level call inside the checkBots modifier.
BotProtected.uniPair: computed Uniswap pair address passed into the bot-protection call and used as allowance spender.
BaconToken.balanceOf mapping: token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and overwritten in list.
BaconToken.allowance mapping: spender allowances, decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
BaconToken.totalSupply: 200000000000000000000000000, used in unchecked multiplication in list.
BaconToken.pancakeRouter: external IUniswapV2Router02 address called with value in list.
BaconToken.wrappedBinance: WBNB token address used for pair computation.
ERC20._balances internal mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
ERC20._allowances internal nested mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
ERC20._totalSupply internal supply variable of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
BotProtected constructor: stores the bot protection address.
checkBots modifier: performs an arbitrary low-level call to protectionFromBots before executing the guarded function body.
SafeMath.add: checked addition.
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction.
SafeMath.mul: checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div: checked division.
ERC20.transfer: delegates to internal _transfer with msg.sender.
ERC20.transferFrom: allowance-checked transfer using SafeMath.
ERC20._transfer: internal balance mutation using SafeMath.
ERC20._approve: internal allowance write.
BaconToken constructor: sets owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair, grants infinite allowances to the router and to tx.origin on the pair.
BaconToken.transfer: forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
BaconToken.transferFrom: bot-protected transfer performing manual, unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
BaconToken.approve: sets allowance for msg.sender.
BaconToken.delegate: owner-restricted arbitrary delegatecall to any address with any calldata.
pairForUniswap: computes a deterministic pair address via keccak256 of sorted tokens and hardcoded init code hash.
BaconToken.list: owner-restricted liquidity listing that calls the router with value, calls protectionFromBots, then writes balances in a loop.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and allowance bookkeeping.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used as the router deadline.
tx.origin: origin of the transaction, used to set owner and allowances, enabling phishing-based privilege escalation.
Low-level call to protectionFromBots in checkBots with selector 0x15274141; executes untrusted external code before the guarded function body.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata, executing untrusted code in the token storage context.
Low-level call to protectionFromBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 inside list; return value and success flag are ignored.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath under solidity ^0.7.0 (unchecked decrease).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath (unchecked arithmetic).
totalSupply * 6 / 100 evaluated with unchecked multiplication in list.
External payable call to pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH with msg.value and block.timestamp-based deadline before state finalization.
owner = tx.origin in the constructor; owner derived from tx.origin is phishing-hijackable.
require(msg.sender == owner) guard that depends on a tx.origin-derived owner for privileged functions delegate and list.

_numList is used as the liquidity amount and contract balance.
_toWho is iterated to assign balances.

pancakeRouter is the target of the addLiquidityETH call in list.

block.timestamp + 600 is used as the router deadline, making execution time miner-influenced.

list enforces require(msg.sender == owner) which depends on the tx.origin-derived owner.

The loop counter indexes _toWho and _amounts while writing balances.
